content_en: Last Saturday, I went to a bookstore to buy a gift for my friend. While I was looking at some books, I heard someone call my name. I turned around and saw an old classmate I had not met for nearly ten years. We were both surprised and excited. We found a quiet coffee shop nearby and talked about our lives. He had moved to another city and started his own business. I told him about my recent experiences, too. Before leaving, we exchanged phone numbers and promised to meet again. It was amazing how one ordinary afternoon brought two old friends together.
content_cn: 上周六，我去书店给朋友买礼物。正当我看书时，听到有人叫我的名字。我转过身，看到了一位将近十年没见过的老同学。我们都感到既惊讶又兴奋。我们在附近找到一家安静的咖啡馆，聊起了各自的生活。他已经搬到了另一座城市，并开始经营自己的生意。我也告诉了他自己最近的一些经历。离开之前，我们交换了电话号码，并约好再次见面。一个普通的下午竟然让两位老朋友重新相聚，这真是令人惊喜。

content_en: A few weeks ago, I had a difficult conversation with my roommate. He often left dirty dishes in the kitchen, and I was getting tired of cleaning them. At first, I wanted to complain, but I knew that might make things worse. Instead, I waited until we were both relaxed and explained how I felt. I also listened to his side of the story. He said he had been very busy and promised to help more. We agreed to share the housework fairly. The conversation was not easy, but it helped us understand each other and made living together much better.
content_cn: 几周前，我和室友进行了一次艰难的谈话。他经常把脏盘子留在厨房里，而我已经厌倦了替他收拾。一开始，我想抱怨，但我知道那可能会让事情变得更糟。相反，我等到我们两个人都放松下来时，才解释自己的感受。我也听了他的说法。他说自己最近一直很忙，并承诺以后会多帮忙。我们同意公平分担家务。这次谈话并不容易，但它帮助我们更好地理解彼此，也让共同生活变得更加愉快。

content_en: One cold morning, I was waiting for the bus when I noticed an older woman carrying several heavy bags. She looked tired and had trouble holding them. A young man nearby offered to help her carry the bags onto the bus. She smiled and thanked him warmly. The man simply nodded and returned to his seat. I was touched by this small act of kindness. It did not take much time or effort, but it made someone's day easier. Since then, I have tried to notice when people need help. Sometimes, a little kindness can mean more than we imagine.
content_cn: 一个寒冷的早晨，我正在等公交车时，注意到一位年长的女士提着几个沉重的袋子。她看起来很疲惫，拿着袋子也有些吃力。附近一位年轻男子主动提出帮她把袋子拿上公交车。她微笑着向他表示感谢。男子只是点了点头，然后回到自己的座位。我被这个小小的善举打动了。这并没有花费多少时间或精力，却让一个人的一天变得轻松了一些。从那以后，我开始留意身边是否有人需要帮助。有时候，一点点善意带来的意义可能超出我们的想象。

content_en: Last year, my company offered me a chance to work on an exciting project. I was interested, but I worried that I did not have enough experience. I spent too much time thinking about the risks and finally turned down the offer. A few months later, I learned that the project had been very successful. I felt disappointed because I had let fear make the decision for me. However, I also learned something important. Opportunities do not always come twice, and we cannot wait until we feel completely ready. Now, I try to consider both the risks and the possible rewards before making a choice.
content_cn: 去年，公司给了我一个参与令人兴奋的项目的机会。我很感兴趣，但担心自己经验不足。我花了太多时间考虑风险，最后还是拒绝了这个机会。几个月后，我得知那个项目取得了很大的成功。我感到失望，因为我让恐惧替自己做了决定。不过，我也学到了重要的一课：机会并不总是会再次出现，而且我们不能一直等到自己完全准备好才行动。现在，在做决定之前，我会尽量同时考虑风险和可能获得的回报。

title_cn: 一个让我差点后悔的决定
content_en: Two years ago, I decided to move to a new city for work. I was excited about the opportunity, but leaving my family and friends was harder than I expected. During the first few weeks, I felt lonely and often wondered if I had made the right choice. I even thought about going back home. Then I joined a local sports club and met some friendly people. Slowly, the new city began to feel like home. Looking back, I am glad I stayed. That decision taught me that difficult changes can bring unexpected opportunities, even when the beginning feels uncomfortable.

expressions.example: She moved to a new city for college.
I hope I made the right choice.
We decided to go back home early.
This small town feels like home to me.
When I look back, I can see how much I learned.

questions.question: Why did the writer move to a new city?
questions.explanation: 文章第一句说明，作者为了工作决定搬到一座新城市。

questions.question: What helped the writer feel more comfortable in the new city?
questions.explanation: 作者加入当地运动俱乐部，并在那里认识了友善的人。

questions.question: What did the writer learn from the experience?
options: Difficult changes can bring unexpected opportunities.
People should never leave their hometown.
questions.answer: Difficult changes can bring unexpected opportunities.
questions.explanation: 作者认识到，艰难的改变虽然开始时不容易，却可能带来新的机会。
